The text describes the Y2K problem, which was a major concern leading up to the year 2000. The Y2K bug referred to the potential failure of computer systems to correctly interpret dates after December 31, 1999, due to the use of two-digit year representations. Global efforts to address this issue were prominent in the late 1990s, specifically between 1997 and 1999. Therefore, the time period indicated by the text is the late 1990s, specifically around 1999.
